_README: Hand corrections to the pediatric radiology-AI paper database, keyed by PMID.
Each value is a partial row: only the fields you list are replaced, and they
are applied when the CSV / markdown are written, never baked into the stored
extraction. So re-running scripts/build_paper_db.py cannot clobber a fix, and
deleting an entry here reverts that row to what the extractor said.
Overridable fields: every column in pedrad_ai.paper_db.COLUMNS except pmid and
the provenance ones, plus 'include' (to force a paper in or out of the table)
Apply with: python scripts/build_paper_db.py --rebuild   (makes no API calls)
Keys beginning with an underscore, like this one, are ignored.
"release_evidence": "CE-marked since 2009; checked on the vendor site 2026-09"
